name: Evolv - Dive Deep. See Clear.
tagline: Shows a planned data centre's real local costs: electricity bills, water use and emissions.

awards: Best Predictive Intelligence by Chestnut Forty

problem: Communities learn after construction that data centres raise bills and drain water.
solution: Models a data-centre configuration's impact on energy, water and emissions with AI insights on a map.
demo_moment: Team-described: place a data centre and see local bills and water impact.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Predictive Intelligence by Chestnut Forty” among 195 submissions.

lessons: Timely local controversies make prediction tools relevant.
